subject: Boardroom metrics snapshot + prep for July QBR
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Selena Martinez <selena@aureliahealth.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Boardroom metrics snapshot + prep for July QBR

Team —

Attaching the June dashboard and a short uptime dump we pulled from the telemetry cluster. This is a leadership-level checkpoint ahead of our July QBR: I want a concise readout for latency, cost, uptime and usage trends focused on production-hosted customers (hosted + dedicated pools). Top-level asks:

- Can each of you confirm the top 2 drivers for the month-over-month change in your area (latency / cost / uptime / usage)?
- Call out any anomaly that needs an operational or product decision before the QBR (e.g., sustained 95th percentile latency regressions, unexpected billings delta, or recurring capacity shortfalls).
- If you need to surface a canary or rollback plan, jot it in a one-line action.

I've attached: monthly_metrics_dashboard_v2.pdf (summary), uptime-digest-202806.csv (per-region) and cost-trend-agg.pptx (preliminary slides). Please reply by EOD Monday (July 1) with assigned owners and an estimated time-to-fix for any items flagged.

Selena — I included Aurelia on the thread so they have visibility for the pilot usage spikes we mentioned on the last call; if anything in the dashboard looks off to you, flag it and we'll follow up.

Thanks —
Laura
Laura Bennett | Head of Operations, Redwood Inference
attachments: [monthly_metrics_dashboard_v2.pdf (pdf), uptime-digest-202806.csv (csv), cost-trend-agg.pptx (pptx)]
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Selena Martinez <selena@aureliahealth.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Jun 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Boardroom metrics snapshot + prep for July QBR

Laura — quick read on infra-backed signals:

1) Latency: 95p increased in eu-west after two kernel updates (June 8 and June 12) — cumulative ~18ms at 95p for request profiles >1k tokens. I recommend a targeted canary revert on the kernel selection for the next 48 hours for the eu-west dedicated pool. Owner: Markus (ops). ETA: 36 hours to stage and validate.

2) Uptime: region-us-east had three short blips (3 x ~5m) due to a storage failover during a scheduled maintenance window — overall SLA not yet breached, but we should include a blameless note in the QBR. Owner: Jonas (infra). ETA: postmortem draft by Fri 6/30.

3) Cost: raw GPU-hours increased 9% month-over-month; primary driver is longer prefix lengths from a small set of high-usage customers (including Aurelia). I'm attaching a quick slice of top-10 accounts.

I'll take the kernel canary plan and will post status in the ops-standup channel.

-Markus
attachments: [infra_slice_top10_accounts.csv (csv)]
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Selena Martinez <selena@aureliahealth.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Jun 2028 08:41:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Boardroom metrics snapshot + prep for July QBR

Short notes from Product/Optimize:

- Usage: We saw a 22% uplift in session length for a cohort of customers running multi-turn chat in hosted mode — that maps to the cost bump Markus flagged. Action: I'll propose a transient quota policy and a customer outreach template to encourage batching and prefix caching while we scope an automated signal. Owner: Grace (product) + CS (Monica to draft outreach). ETA: draft outreach by Mon 7/1.

- Metrics for the QBR: please include both mean latency and 95/99p by model family, not just global percentiles. It helps the product narrative. Also add cost-per-successful-request (CPR) as a derived metric for the finance slice.

- OKR tie-in: Our reliability OKR (R1) expects <0.5% monthly SLA incidents — the three blips push the visible exposure higher for narrative; flagging for leadership.

Questions:
1) Markus — can you slice the latency by model-family in the kernel canary window?
2) Jonas — can we append raw eviction counts from the cache layer to the uptime dump (helps explain jitter)?

Thanks —
Grace
From: Selena Martinez <selena@aureliahealth.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurements@aureliahealth.com, laura.bennett@redwood.ai, markus.klein@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 1 Jul 2028 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Boardroom metrics snapshot + prep for July QBR

Hi Laura — thanks for pulling this together and looping us in. A couple quick items from our side:

- We did notice the usage surge on June 12 that lines up with a pilot wave we ran; we will throttle a subset of pipelines tomorrow to measure impact.
- Can you confirm whether the uptime blips in us-east were customer-facing? We saw a handful of dropped connections around 10:23 PDT on June 19 that impacted a low-volume integration (no data loss, just timeouts).

If the kernel canary affects model latency for the eu-west pool, please also share the rollback threshold — our SRE will want to sync.

Appreciate the quick visibility — happy to join the July 3 prep call if helpful.

Best,
Selena Martinez
Director of Integrations, Aurelia Health
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>

Thanks all — consolidating final asks and owners below for the QBR pack: 

Action items (owners + ETA):
- Markus: Stage kernel canary for eu-west and produce model-family latency slice; ETA: 36h.
- Jonas: Postmortem draft for us-east blips and append cache eviction counts to uptime-digest; ETA: EOD Fri 6/30 (draft) / Final Mon 7/1.
- Grace: Draft customer outreach template + proposed transient quota policy; ETA: Mon 7/1.
- Laura: Synthesize one-slide impact summary (latency, cost delta, uptime exposure) for board; ETA: Tue 7/2 10:00 PT.
- Selena: confirm whether Aurelia will throttle pilot and share any findings on Jun-12 wave; Tentative: throttle test Tue 7/2.

Meeting: scheduling the boardroom dry-run on Wed 7/3 11:00 PT — please confirm availability on Calendly: Calendly:laura_bennett/qbr-slot

Notes: Include derived CPR and model-family percentiles on the QBR slide. If any owner needs escalation for headcount or infra spend to hit a fix, call it out in the reply and I will elevate to the CFO/Head of Eng.

I'll pull the final slides together after your updates.

Laura
Laura Bennett | Head of Operations, Redwood Inference
